claim_scores.rationale: Uses `SchemaAwareDummy(DummyLM)` with `dspy.JSONAdapter()`, and sets both `supported_params` to include `response_format` and `supports_response_schema = True`.
Defines `Loose.data` as `dict[str, Any]`, the open-ended mapping annotation required to trigger the incompatible structured-output case.
Records `loose_format` from LM history and asserts it equals exactly `{"type": "json_object"}`.
Defines `Tight.answer` as a normal typed output (`str`), which exercises the structured-output branch for the typed case.
Validates the typed `response_format` as a generated schema class via `isinstance(tight_format, type)` and `issubclass(..., pydantic.BaseModel)`.
